## Wave 3 Summary

This wave executes the neutrino/flavor-sector carry-forward set from the S100a/S100b dual-session campaign: (W3a) the S-3 surviving-map gate triple — the sector-keyed exponential Casimir envelope on the Dirac-neutrino towers (`S101-NU-DIRAC-ENVELOPE-MAP`), the doublet-split off-diagonal seesaw texture under the now-landed W-2 counting convention (`S101-NU-DIRAC-OFFDIAG-TEXTURE`), and the hawking-side greybody derivation of the neutrino-sector slope κ_ν (`S101-KAPPA-NU-GREYBODY`); and (W3b) the D5 gap-equation derivation (`S101-D5-MD-GAPEQ`, the interaction-level m_D route — the substrate analog of the parent class's gap equation, proceeding as DERIVATION since S-3 landed no forcing structure), the Z₃-phase rephasing certification (`S101-Z3-PHASE-REPHASING-INVARIANCE`), and the Pati-Salam Model-C fork (`S101-CCS-MODELC-KO-DERIVATION` → `S101-PS-RGE-MODELC-SIN2-MZ`, hard-sequenced). One CONDITIONAL-HOLD (MR-TEXTURE-ROUTE-B) is recorded in §"Decision Points" and is NOT dispatched. Carry-forward sources: `session-100a-campaign-landscape-synthesis.md` §V.5–V.8, `session-100a-yukawa-wall-scope-synthesis.md` §V.1–V.3, `s100a-w5-d5-seesaw-adjudication-workshop.md` Wrap-Up CF (canonical verbatim at :1001), `session-100b-campaign-closeout-synthesis.md` §V.5–V.7, `session-100b-w2-workingpaper.md` CF blocks (:267–283). Per the binding-text rule (context §"Binding-text rule"), thresholds below are TRANSCRIBED from those canonical specs, never re-derived; plan-freeze additions (the gate-7 band, the gate-1 W-2/W-3 convention resolution) are explicitly marked as plan-freeze pins with their derivations shown.

**Wave classification** (`.claude/rules/wave-classification.md`): all seven gates are **COMPUTE-class** — every gate produces a `.py` script with a numerical or exact-algebraic PASS predicate against a pre-registered threshold (fails M1/M2 of the METHODOLOGY conjunction; none is allowlisted under M4). No MIXED-class decomposition required.

**Run-order**: independent of Waves 1–2 for the closed-form gates (1, 2, 5, 6, 7 consume published npz scalars + paper primaries — no s84-cache eigenvalue consumption). Gates 3 and 4 touch the s84 L12 cache (floors / B-branch spectrum): per the cross-wave pin (partition §"Cross-wave pins" item 1), if dispatched BEFORE Wave 1's `S101-TAU0-OPERATOR-CANONICITY` L4 caveat-lift lands, their verdict lines MUST carry the A19 UNTRUSTED-UPSTREAM extra-row (`extra_rows` on `emit_verdict`); if dispatched after, cite full-confidence (lift is theorem-backed, A-C3 σ-blind lemma). Within-wave ordering: gate 3 runs BEFORE or alongside gate 1 (soft ordering — gate 1's candidate (c) clause is conditional on gate 3's landing; gate 1 marks candidate (c) N/A if gate 3 has not landed at its dispatch). Gate 7 runs strictly AFTER gate 6 (hard dependency — see gate 7 "Depends on" and §"Decision Points").

## §W3-1. S101-NU-DIRAC-ENVELOPE-MAP

**Plan-freeze resolution of the S-3 conditional-consumption clause** (both workshops now landed; this block discharges the clause and is the binding convention pin for this gate):

1. **W-2 convention pin**: the adjudicated counting convention is the fifth-axis pin `RATIO-NORMALIZED-TRACE-MEAN` (block-trace state-evaluation face ⟨ω⟩_g; W-2 workshop Effected-In-Session item 2). The pre-registered S-3 grid's exponent argument is the **Casimir invariant C₂(p,q)** — a representation-theory label, counting-convention-BLIND — so the W-2 landing does NOT replace the grid (the "may replace floor-C₂ data with block-trace ⟨ω⟩_g" branch of the S-3 conditional clause does not fire: the grid never consumed floor data). The pin's operative content for this gate: (i) the convention tag on the verdict line carries the fifth axis; (ii) the generation→sector orientation for the NEUTRINO towers is the C₂-ASCENDING map gen1→(0,0), gen2→(1,0)⊕(0,1), gen3→(1,1) (consistent with the W-2-pinned C₂-DESCENDING charged-lepton orientation τ=(1,0), μ=(1,1), e=(3,0) — the two sectors run OPPOSITE directions in C₂, which is exactly the II.3 widening chain); (iii) any block spectral statistic incidentally consumed must be ⟨·⟩_g trace-mean, never block-sum.
2. **W-3 carrier-reading pin**: the floor-stratum same-object test CLOSED NEGATIVE (W-3 workshop Key finding 1: the geometric Connes-distance ladder is NOT Casimir-linear on the landed floor data). The s_ν exponent in this gate is therefore read as a **sector-keyed threshold/greybody slope** (the S99 four-lens modulus exp(−d/ℓ) = Γ·exp(−2πωᵢ/κ) face), NOT a geometric-distance slope. Composite carrier discrimination (Reading A vs Reading B) is OWNED by `S101-ENVELOPE-CARRIER-DISCRIMINATE` (Wave 2) and is NOT re-adjudicated here. This pin is what makes candidate (c) (the κ_ν-derived exponent from gate 3) the structurally privileged candidate if it lands.

## §W3-2. S101-NU-DIRAC-OFFDIAG-TEXTURE

**Prerequisite-discharge note**: the S-3 V.2 BLOCKING prerequisite ("PRE-REG-INC if W-2 has not landed by plan-freeze") is DISCHARGED — W-2 landed 2026-06-07 with the binding unit ruling (B6(iii) verbatim, workshop Effected-In-Session item 3): ε_LX OFF-diagonal payloads (|w| = 1/√6, arg w ∈ {π, ±2π/3}) are **counting-INDEPENDENT**; DIAGONAL d-entries are tagged `RATIO-BLOCKSUM` (as-computed P1 class) and re-express under the pinned `RATIO-NORMALIZED-TRACE-MEAN` convention. The old PRE-REG-INC routing is removed; this gate runs.

```yaml
# ---- Identity ----
gate_id: "S101-NU-DIRAC-OFFDIAG-TEXTURE"
schema_version: "R3"
trigger: "[VERIFY]"
classification: "PARTICLE"
agent_type: "dirac-antimatter-theorist"
hypothesis: >
  Under the landed W-2 unit pinning, the doublet-split off-diagonal texture
  m_D ∝ [[d, w],[w*, d]] on the (1,0)+(0,1) doublet, pushed through the
  diagonal-M_R seesaw, lands the gen-3/gen-2 split ratio in 2.4883 ± 1% with
  scale within 5% of substrate-natural, while preserving the m1 = 0
  rank-deficiency (no |s|^2-channel (0,0)<->(1,1) element).

method:
  description: >
    2x2 algebra + seesaw substitution (no diagonalization beyond the closed
    2x2). Step A (unit pin): express the W2-2 off-diagonal |w| = 1/sqrt(6)
    EXACT (counting-INDEPENDENT) and the diagonal d-entries (npz d-vector,
    as-computed RATIO-BLOCKSUM class) in ONE unit system under the pinned
    RATIO-NORMALIZED-TRACE-MEAN convention; the conversion of d is the only
    new computation — document it as an explicit substitution chain in-script.
    Step B (texture): on the (1,0)+(0,1) doublet the S99 BDI reality
    adjudication forces d1 = d2 = d (J-compatibility: [J, m_D] = 0 block
    condition forces equal doublet diagonals; w unconstrained including
    phase; eigenvalue split depends on |w| only — machine-verified at
    bdi_pair_max_rel_dev ~ 1.1e-15 in the W2-2 npz). Eigenstates: gens 2,3 =
    d -/+ |w| (gen 3 = heavy = d + |w|); gen 1 = (0,0) decoupled, m1 = 0
    CG-protected at s-linear order [(2,0)x(0,0) = (2,0) != (0,1)].
    Step C (seesaw): m_nu = m_D^T M_R^{-1} m_D with M_R = diag of the D_K
    B-branch fold energies (M_R_MKK from the npz); compute the light-mass /
    Yukawa split ratio vs the required 2.4882512 and the absolute scale vs
    Y2_S99. Step D (rank-deficiency sub-criterion): verify NO |s|^2-channel
    (0,0)<->(1,1) element is introduced at any step — the channel is
    CG-admissible [(0,2)x(2,0) ⊇ (1,1)] so its absence is a CONSTRAINT to
    verify, not an automatic property; any nonzero value there lifts m1 = 0
    and FAILS the sub-criterion.
  producing_script: "computations/session-101/s101_nu_dirac_offdiag_texture.py"

# ---- PRDR Checklist (8 items) ----
operator:
  type: "ratio (three-clause AND)"
  form: >
    Clause 1 (shape): |S - 2.4882512|/2.4882512 <= 0.01 where S is the
    unit-pinned split ratio (d+|w|)/(d-|w|) propagated through the seesaw.
    Clause 2 (scale): |Y2_texture/Y2_S99 - 1| <= 0.05 at substrate-natural
    normalization. Clause 3 (rank): |s|^2-channel (0,0)<->(1,1) element = 0
    (exact/machine-eps). PASS = 1 AND 2 AND 3; INFO = 1 AND 3, NOT 2;
    FAIL = unit-pinned x = |w|/d outside [0.405, 0.449] (binding transcription
    of the ±5%-in-shape window around 0.426650) OR clause 3 violated.

strict_PASS_boundary:
  value: "shape rel-dev = 0.01; scale rel-dev = 0.05; |w|/d window [0.405, 0.449]; rank channel = 0 at THEOREM tolerance 1e-12"
  direction: "<="

boundary_reachable_analytically:
  bool: true
  proof_ref: >
    Required x = |w|/d = (S-1)/(S+1) = 1.4882512/3.4882512 = 0.4266503 is
    closed-form in the required split S = 2.4882512
    (session-100a-yukawa-wall-scope-synthesis.md:119); the substrate-exact
    |w| = 1/sqrt(6) = 0.4082483 sits 4.5% below — whether the unit-pinned d
    closes or opens that 4.5% adjacency is exactly what the W-2 convention
    now makes computable. The [0.405, 0.449] window is transcribed BINDING
    from landscape §V.6 (endpoint re-derivation is an in-script DIAGNOSTIC
    only, never a threshold edit).

reachable_rationals:
  includes_integer_mesh: false
  mesh_density: "single evaluation point (the W-2-pinned unit system); no scan"

machinery_pin_map:
  N_eval: "1 texture x 1 pinned unit system; 3x3 embedding for the rank check"
  L_max: "N/A — consumes published npz scalars (L_max=12 lineage documented in the npz convention fields)"
  scan_range: "N/A — no swept parameter (the unit pin is DERIVED from the W-2 ruling, not scanned; deriving-then-choosing among unit systems would be convention-shopping, PROHIBITED Class 1)"
  step_size: "N/A"
  tolerance: "shape 0.01 RATIO; scale 0.05 RATIO; rank channel 1e-12 THEOREM"
  scheme: "TYPE-I-SEESAW-DOUBLET-SPLIT-OFFDIAG-W22-TEXTURE"
  convention: "RATIO-NORMALIZED-TRACE-MEAN-UNITPIN-OFFDIAG-INVARIANT-DIAG-RETAGGED"
  random_seed: "N/A — deterministic"
  GPU_path: "cpu-cap-OMP8 (2x2 and 3x3 algebra only)"
  w_source: "abs_w_phi (= 1/sqrt(6) EXACT at all three Z3 points) + arg_w_M2_phi from s100a_yukawa_overlap_offdiag.npz (audit 871573da...)"
  d_source: "d-vector from s100a_yukawa_overlap_offdiag.npz verdict-line d=[7.8935e-01, 1.0000e+00, 3.3183e-01] (as-computed RATIO-BLOCKSUM class per W-2 ruling; re-expressed under the pinned convention in Step A)"
  MR_source: "M_R_MKK from s100a_md_normalization.npz = D_K B-branch fold energies [1.00439566, 1.07857332, 1.17000260] M_KK"
  bdi_reality_pin: "S99 BDI adjudication: d1 = d2 forced by [J, m_D] = 0 on the (1,0)/(0,1) doublet (W2-2 npz bdi_pair_max_rel_dev ~ 1.1e-15 as the machine witness)"

audit_discriminators:
  audit_sha256_inputs: ["script", "s100a_yukawa_overlap_offdiag.npz SHA", "s100a_md_normalization.npz SHA", "canonical_constants.py SHA at runtime", "pinmap (unit-pin procedure, window, tolerances)"]
  content_sha256_inputs: ["script"]

substitution_chain:
  required: true
  content: |
    Claim (split direction + window placement): the heavy doublet eigenstate
    is d + |w| (gen 3), the light is d - |w| (gen 2), so the split ratio
    S(x) = (1+x)/(1-x) with x = |w|/d is MONOTONE INCREASING in x on
    0 < x < 1, and the required S fixes x uniquely.
      Step 1: m_D doublet block = [[d, w],[w*, d]], d real > 0 (J-forced
              d1 = d2; phase of w absorbable in this 2x2 — full 3x3 phase
              fate is gate 5's question, NOT consumed here)
      Step 2: eigenvalues = d ± |w|                       [2x2 exact]
      Step 3: S = (d + |w|)/(d - |w|) = (1 + x)/(1 - x), x = |w|/d in (0,1)
      Step 4: dS/dx = 2/(1-x)^2 > 0  => monotone increasing; S > 1 always
              (heavy = +|w| branch); S = 2.4882512 <=> x = (S-1)/(S+1)
              = 0.4266503 (unique).
      Step 5: substrate-exact |w| = 1/sqrt(6) = 0.4082483 at the AS-COMPUTED
              d = 1 (unit-normalized kernel): x_raw = 0.408248, 4.5% BELOW
              0.426650 => shape -9.2% low IF the unit pin leaves d = 1
              [S(0.408248) = 2.3797, dev = -4.4%... read-off: S(x_raw) =
              1.408248/0.591752 = 2.37999; (2.37999-2.48825)/2.48825 =
              -4.35%]. The gate's live content: does the W-2 d-retag move x
              INTO [0.405, 0.449] and the ±1% shape band, or out of the
              window entirely.
    Direction read-off: sign_verdict keys on S > 1 with heavy = d + |w|
    (structurally forced); magnitude_verdict keys on clause 1; regime_verdict
    VALID iff the unit-pin conversion is single-valued under the W-2 ruling
    (MARGINAL if the ruling admits two readings for d — documented, not
    chosen-between).

input_files:
  canonical_constants:
    path: "computations/_shared/canonical_constants.py"
    sha256: "<computed-at-runtime>"   # M_KK, v_ew, Sigma_mnu_FW
  yukawa_offdiag_npz:
    path: "computations/session-100a/s100a_yukawa_overlap_offdiag.npz"
    sha256: "23d386dfa7e6d54d11006bd6d631fa860c156ea223e9c36b9b21eb6f3217dba2"
  md_normalization_npz:

# ---- Conditional blocks ----
fb_pair:
  forward: "W-2 workshop unit ruling (B6(iii)); S100a-YUKAWA-OVERLAP-OFFDIAG (|w|, arg w, d-vector); S100a-MD-NORMALIZATION (Y_S99, M_R); S99 BDI reality adjudication"
  backward: "MR-TEXTURE-ROUTE-B HOLD trigger (a NON-DIAGONAL m_D landing here fires the route-(b) trigger — see Decision Points); gate 5 consumes the same texture's PHASE content independently; CLASS-2 corridor status in the constraint map"

# ---- Output artifacts ----

    artifact_kind: "plot"
    optional: false
  verdict_line:

    must_contain: "^S101-NU-DIRAC-OFFDIAG-TEXTURE:.* audit_sha256=[a-f0-9]{64}"

# ---- Verdict rubric ----
PASS_meaning: >
  CLASS-2 closes BOTH shape and scale at substrate-natural normalization —
  the off-diagonal texture is the surviving substrate-forward map, and the

FAIL_meaning: >

INFO_meaning: >
  Shape lands in 2.4883 ± 1% with rank preserved, but scale misses the 5%
  substrate-natural band — parallel to gate 1's INFO: shape corridor open
  through CLASS-2, scale wall stands (one external constant).

effort:

  estimated_time: "~0.2 wave-equivalents (~1 h; 2x2 algebra + seesaw substitution)"

substrate_framing: |
  PARTICLE. The texture IS the substrate's BDI fund<->antifund s-linear
  channel content: |w| = 1/sqrt(6) is Weingarten-exact Haar geometry on the
  Jensen fiber, arg(w) is the second-Z3, and the doublet diagonal equality

  the same J whose compatibility with D_K enforces particle-antiparticle
```

## §W3-3. S101-KAPPA-NU-GREYBODY

**Corner-declaration discipline** (anti-iterate-until-PASS): the magnitude comparison is made on ONE pre-declared (g, q) corner of the S-3 Eq.-(4) grid. The plan pins the PRIMARY corner here; the producing script declares it in its header and logs it in the first 20 lines of stdout BEFORE the κ_ν derivation runs. Primary corner: **(g = C₂, q → 0⁺), s_ν^target = +0.546948** — the pure-exponential corner is the greybody-natural form (the S99 hawking mechanism y_i ∝ Γ(ω_i)·e^{−2πω_i/κ} is a pure exponential in the frequency variable with no power prefactor; a Casimir-proportional frequency map ω_i ∝ C₂,i then gives g = C₂, q = 0). If the derivation lands structurally on a DIFFERENT grid corner (e.g., the greybody factor Γ(ω) supplies a power prefactor q > 0), the comparison maps to that corner's form-equivalent s_ν via Eq. (4) — admissible ONLY because the corner is forced by the derivation's structure and is documented BEFORE the magnitude is read off (structure-first, magnitude-second ordering inside the script; the six-corner grid is the closed admissible set, no extension).

```yaml
# ---- Identity ----
gate_id: "S101-KAPPA-NU-GREYBODY"
schema_version: "R3"
trigger: "[SIGN]"
classification: "PHONONIC"
agent_type: "hawking-theorist"
hypothesis: >
  The S99 sector-kappa ladder (lepton 1.89 / up 1.29 / down 0.78) extends to
  the Dirac-neutrino channel: a substrate-derived kappa_nu exists whose sign
  AND magnitude reproduce a shape-exact s_nu within 5% on the pre-declared
  (g=C2, q->0+) corner (target +0.546948) — i.e., the II.3 sign flip
  (widening, OPPOSITE to all three charged sectors) EMERGES from the
  horizon/greybody machinery rather than being externally imposed.

method:
  description: >
    Hawking-side derivation + cross-check (the S99 fermion-mass panel
    machinery, extended). Step A: reconstruct the sector-kappa construction
    from the S99 panel (y_i ∝ Γ(ω_i)·exp(−2πω_i/κ_sector); κ_exit = 47.61
    M_KK with the Kitaev identity 2π·T(a_4) = κ_exit; greybody Γ(ω) from the
    S95 W4-3 Pöschl–Teller barrier, transmitted_fraction = 0.512; sector
    dependence through per-sector fiber sub-blocks / (c²−v²) gradients).
    Step B: derive the Dirac-NEUTRINO channel's (ω_i, κ_ν, Γ) assignment on
    the towers (0,0)/(1,0)+(0,1)/(1,1) — the structural question is whether
    the neutrino channel's mode-frequency map ω_i(C2) INVERTS (decreasing in
    C2) or its transmission is enhanced (super-radiant/transmission-enhanced
    channel) such that d ln Y/dC2 > 0 emerges; or whether the construction
    FORBIDS the widening sign for every admissible configuration. Step C: map
    the derived kappa_nu to s_nu^pred in the Eq.-(4) variables on the
    pre-declared corner; compare sign first, then magnitude vs +0.546948.
    Step D (cross-check): verify the charged-sector ladder (1.89/1.29/0.78)
    is reproduced by the same machinery before reading the neutrino number
    (anti-rediscovery + machinery validation in one step). A19 note: if
    dispatched before Wave 1's L4 lift, any s84-cache floor consumption
    carries the UNTRUSTED-UPSTREAM extra-row on emit_verdict.
  producing_script: "computations/session-101/s101_kappa_nu_greybody.py"

# ---- PRDR Checklist (8 items) ----
operator:
  type: "inequality (sign clause + magnitude clause)"
  form: >
    Sign clause: sign(s_nu^pred) = +1 (the widening direction).
    Magnitude clause: |s_nu^pred - 0.546948|/0.546948 <= 0.05 on the
    pre-declared corner. PASS = sign AND magnitude; INFO = sign only
    (magnitude outside 5%); FAIL = the greybody construction FORBIDS the
    widening sign (a derivation-grade exclusion: d ln Y/dC2 < 0 for every
    admissible neutrino-channel configuration — not merely a wrong number).

strict_PASS_boundary:
  value: "magnitude rel-dev = 0.05 at s_nu^target = +0.546948 (pre-declared corner); sign = +1 exact"
  direction: "<="

boundary_reachable_analytically:
  bool: true
  proof_ref: >
    The target +0.546948 is the Eq.-(4) closed form at (g=C2, q->0+):
    s_nu = ln(2.4882512)/(5/3) = 0.5469481 (transcribed from
    session-100a-yukawa-wall-scope-synthesis.md:77 + grid row :105 — the II.3
    required per-unit-C2 widening). The 5% band is the binding S-3 V.3
    tolerance (landscape §V.7), transcribed unchanged.

reachable_rationals:
  includes_integer_mesh: false
  mesh_density: "single derived value vs single target; admissible corner set = 6 (closed)"

machinery_pin_map:
  N_eval: "1 derived kappa_nu; 3 charged-sector reproduction checks (1.89/1.29/0.78); 1 sign + 1 magnitude comparison"
  L_max: "12 iff s84 cache floors consumed (lineage per A19 note); N/A for the closed-form legs"
  scan_range: "N/A — derivation, not a scan (no parameter is tuned toward the target; the kappa_nu value is read out of the construction once)"
  step_size: "N/A"
  tolerance: "magnitude 0.05 RATIO; charged-sector reproduction check 0.02 RATIO (diagnostic, non-gating); sign exact"
  scheme: "HAWKING-GREYBODY-SECTOR-KAPPA-LADDER-EXTENSION"
  convention: "ABSOLUTE"
  random_seed: "N/A — deterministic"
  GPU_path: "cpu-cap-OMP8 (scalar/small-vector algebra; Poschl-Teller transmission closed-form)"
  corner_pin: "PRIMARY (g=C2, q->0+), s_nu^target = +0.546948; alternate corner admissible ONLY if structurally forced by the derivation and declared pre-magnitude (see corner-declaration discipline above); form-equivalents via Eq. (4)"
  kappa_exit_pin: "kappa_exit = 47.61 M_KK (S95 white-hole analysis; Kitaev identity 2*pi*T(a_4) = kappa_exit, capstone §5.3); all three KINDs (kappa_exit, kappa_entry, T_GH) admissible per the S99 panel KIND table — the KIND used is declared in the verdict value string"

  ladder_pin: "charged-sector targets lepton 1.89 / up 1.29 / down 0.78 (S99 four-lens panel, session-99-fermion-mass-hawking.md + panel synthesis)"
  regulator_pin: "a_4^{Pauli-Villars} — the single Seeley-DeWitt citation in this gate is the Kitaev-identity anchor 2*pi*T(a_4) = kappa_exit; T(a_4) carries the S96 PV lineage (s96 companion row 'regulator=a_4^{Pauli-Villars}'); no other a_n is consumed"

  content_sha256_inputs: ["script"]

substitution_chain:
  required: true
  content: |
    Claim (what the sign flip MEANS in greybody variables — the [SIGN]
    pre-registration): the charged sectors realize NARROWING because the
    relic occupation y ∝ Γ(ω)·e^{−2πω/κ} DECREASES in ω and the charged
    mode-frequency map has ω increasing in C2; the neutrino channel needs
    the COMPOSITE map increasing in C2.
      Step 1: y(ω) = Γ(ω)·e^{−2πω/κ}, κ > 0          [Hawking 1975 occupation;
              S99 panel eq.; Γ = greybody transmission]
      Step 2: d ln y/dC2 = [d ln Γ/dω − 2π/κ]·(dω/dC2)
      Step 3: charged sectors (measured): d ln m/dC2 = −S0 < 0 with

      Step 4: neutrino requirement (II.3): d ln Y/dC2 = +0.5469 > 0. By

              EITHER (i) dω/dC2 < 0 (mode-frequency inversion on the
```

## §W3-4. S101-D5-MD-GAPEQ

**Sequencing status (RESOLVED at plan-freeze)**: the OQ-2 upstream dependency is DISCHARGED — the S-3 D_F-texture solo review landed with **NO forcing structure** (`session-100a-yukawa-wall-scope-synthesis.md`; prerequisite table row 3). This gate therefore **PROCEEDS AS DERIVATION**, not verification, exactly per the binding CF (`sessions/session-100a/workshops/s100a-w5-d5-seesaw-adjudication-workshop.md:1001-1006`, Wrap-Up CF canonical verbatim; thresholds transcribed unchanged).

**am1 pre-flight (MANDATORY — runs FIRST inside the gate, BEFORE the stationarity compute)**: parse-tree the (0,0)⊕B-branch Y_i-shape observable against the S99 PROVEN inner-fluctuation-impotence schema (`sessions/permanent-results-registry.md` two-wall schema — verified at lines 21046–21050 on 2026-06-07; the producing script re-greps the (W1)/(W2)/(W3) markers rather than trusting absolute line numbers). Declare ONE of: **multiplicity-keyed** (the observable rides the multiplicity factor ℂ^{m(p,q)}) ⟹ the bare A_K-built inner-fluctuation route is walled **BY THEOREM** (W3: inner `A = Σaᵢ[D_K,bᵢ]`, twisted-inner `Ω¹_σ`, opposite-action `JAJ⁻¹` are ALL multiplicity-scalar) and the stationarity re-scopes to the corollary's **external-non-LI fibre-connection class** breaking homogeneity wall W2 while preserving reality wall W1 (`[J, D_K + ε_LX] = 0` block-by-block); or **sector-keyed** (Z₃ = (p−q) mod 3 generation map; W3 silent) ⟹ proceed as drafted. Anti-rediscovery check: `S96-MATTER-A4-YUKAWA-RATIO` (INFO, 1.5883138995005102, scheme CCM-2007-inner-fluctuation-spin0-Higgs; verified `computations/session-96/s96_gate_verdicts.txt:84`) — the stationarity must not re-derive that ratio as if new. Genre disambiguation: this stationarity is over the YUKAWA fluctuation, distinct from the S95 τ-selection closures (T-STAR-ONELOOP-ORIGIN FAIL concerned the moduli, not the Yukawa) — no conflict.

**am2 regime pin (BINDING)**: the derivation MUST NOT assume the weak-coupling exponential gap form. The substrate sits at the van Hove fold (flat-band-adjacent DOS), where the parent class's gap equation takes the **Khodel–Shaginyan LINEAR form Δ ∝ g·N(0)** (`researchers/Volovik/16_2018_Volovik_Graphite_Flat_Band_Superconductivity.md`, `researchers/Volovik/17_2019_Volovik_Flat_Band_Planckian_Metal.md` — methodological sources, SHA-pinned below). The DOS regime is a declared, pinned input reconstructed from the L12 cache B-branch spectrum.

**TWO τ-anchors — NEVER conflated (V-R3-E1, workshop :938–942, transcribed)**: **τ = 0.107** is the B-branch eigenvalue-ordering crossing (inventory Row #73 — the NO-ordering anchor); **τ_fold = 0.190** is the DOS-singularity regime pin (canonical `tau_fold`). These are DISTINCT substrate features — an eigenvalue-ordering crossing vs the DOS singularity — sitting 0.083 apart on the deformation axis. The producing script consumes τ_fold for the am2 regime and NEVER cites τ = 0.107 as a fold-position claim (and vice versa: the ordering claim is NOT a fold-position claim). Both anchors travel with their citations.

**Plan-freeze addition (marked per the binding-text rule)**: the binding trichotomy names PASS (both clauses), INFO (scale-in-band with shape-FAIL), and FAIL (both-fail) — it leaves the (shape-in-band ∧ scale-out-of-band) cell unnamed. That cell is pre-registered here as **INFO** (parallel to gates 1/2's INFO semantics: shape corridor open, scale wall stands). Derivation: the two clauses are independent axes; a single-clause hold is structurally intermediate on either axis, and assigning the unnamed cell to FAIL would make FAIL ambiguous between one-axis and two-axis exclusions (the binding FAIL meaning "closes the interaction-level route" is the TWO-axis exclusion).

```yaml
  pre-flight is the structure-first step: identify WHICH algebraic class
  the observable lives in (multiplicity vs sector grading) BEFORE
  computing, because the S99 theorem already fixes the answer for one of
  the two classes.
```

## §W3-5. S101-Z3-PHASE-REPHASING-INVARIANCE

**Adjudication context (transcribed from the binding sources)**: the S100a/S100b schedule's cross-session adjudication #5 settled arg(w) vs δ_CP as **DIFFERENT MATRICES** — arg(w) ∈ {π, ±2π/3} lives on the charged-lepton Dirac Yukawa off-diagonal (second-Z₃ on the BDI fund↔antifund s-LINEAR channel; S100a W2-2, |w| = 1/√6 EXACT, Weingarten-exact; verdict anchors `computations/session-100a/s100a_gate_verdicts.txt:36-40`, audit `871573da729c59722ee060b37c70741f8d917e2560fe11ef74910f6be3bd2925`), while δ_CP ∈ {0, π} is the PMNS Dirac-phase restriction (S99-W3-SEESAW-SUMMNU; canonical `delta_CP_PMNS_substrate`) — but left ONE residual forward derivation not landed anywhere: whether the Z₃ phase content is removable by field rephasing or propagates into PMNS δ_CP through U_PMNS = U_ℓ†U_ν. This gate lands that residual (binding: `session-100b-campaign-closeout-synthesis.md:233-237` V.15 + `session-100b-w2-workingpaper.md:281-283` CF-W2-3; thresholds transcribed unchanged). Gate 2 of this wave explicitly defers the full 3×3 phase fate HERE (gate 2 chain Step 1: "phase of w absorbable in this 2x2 — full 3x3 phase fate is gate 5's question").

**Sector guard (BINDING)**: φ_CP^K7 = π/2 is the TRANSIT-sector constant — it NEVER enters the leptonic grid (`s100b_w2_3_mr_texture_class.npz` scoping: the W2-3 sector guard held throughout). The producing script asserts its absence from every evaluated configuration.

```yaml
# ---- Identity ----
gate_id: "S101-Z3-PHASE-REPHASING-INVARIANCE"
schema_version: "R3"
trigger: "[VERIFY]"
classification: "PARTICLE"
agent_type: "dirac-antimatter-theorist"
hypothesis: >
  The Z3 phase content of the charged-lepton texture (Weingarten-exact
  arg(w) in {pi, +2pi/3, -2pi/3}; |w| = 1/sqrt(6) EXACT) is removable by
  field rephasing -- the Jarlskog invariant J vanishes at every
  substrate-pinned configuration -- certifying consistency with the
  substrate-forced delta_CP in {0, pi} (canonical
  delta_CP_PMNS_substrate); the alternative (a non-removable phase forcing
  delta_CP outside {0, pi}) is a genuine S100a <-> S100b cross-session
  contradiction.

method:
  description: >
    Rephasing-invariance analysis; 3x3 algebra ONLY (no diagonalization
    compute beyond closed-form 3x3). Step A: construct the 3x3 charged-
    lepton matrix from the npz d-vector + the w channel on the BDI
    fund<->antifund pair per the S100a W2-2 construction (W-2 pinned
    orientation tau=(1,0), mu=(1,1), e=(3,0)); the doublet block is
    [[d, w],[w*, d]] with d real (J-forced d1 = d2, S99 BDI). Step B:
    factor U_l analytically -- the doublet block diagonalizes as
    U_l(2x2) = D(phi)*U_0 with D(phi) = diag(1, e^{-i*phi}) and U_0 real
    (chain Steps 2-3). Step C: build U_PMNS = U_l^dagger U_nu on the
    substrate-pinned U_nu legs: (leg i, ALWAYS) diagonal-m_D (the S100a
    landed maps -- both diagonal; U_nu real up to Majorana signs; M_R
    real-diagonal by J-reality T1/T11, m_1 = 0, NO ordering); (leg ii,
    CONDITIONAL) the gate-2 doublet-texture m_D pushed through the seesaw,
    consumed IFF S101-NU-DIRAC-OFFDIAG-TEXTURE has landed at dispatch
    (pre-registered conditional mirroring gate 1's candidate-(c) clause;
    else value string carries texture_leg=N/A). Step D: compute the
    Jarlskog rephasing invariant J = Im(U_e1 U_mu2 U*_e2 U*_mu1) at each
    of the 3 Z3 points x each U_nu leg; J is itself rephasing-invariant
    and complete for the Dirac phase at non-degenerate angles, so J = 0
    <=> delta_CP in {0, pi} and J != 0 proves non-removability OUTRIGHT
    (no rephasing search needed). Step E (reported, non-gating): where the
    phase relocates into MAJORANA phases (column phases on the neutrino
    side), report the relocation flag -- the Z3 content surviving as
    Majorana phases is physically meaningful for the m_bb context (Row
    #80 delta_CP-degeneracy framing) without touching delta_CP. Angle
    MAGNITUDES are NOT gated here (that is the MD-NORMALIZATION lineage);
    only the phase fate is. Sector-guard assertion: phi_CP^K7 = pi/2
    absent from every configuration.
  producing_script: "computations/session-101/s101_z3_phase_rephasing_invariance.py"

# ---- PRDR Checklist (8 items) ----
operator:
  type: "equality (rephasing-invariant zero-set test, three-branch)"
  form: >
    Discriminator: J = Im(U_e1 U_mu2 U*_e2 U*_mu1) on U_PMNS =
    U_l^dagger U_nu, evaluated on the closed configuration set (3 Z3
    points x <= 2 U_nu legs). PASS = |J| <= 1e-12 (THEOREM) for ALL
    configurations: rephasing-removable; delta_CP in {0, pi} consistency
    CERTIFIED vs canonical delta_CP_PMNS_substrate; Majorana relocation
    reported non-gating. FAIL = |J| > 1e-12 at ANY substrate-pinned
    configuration: a non-removable phase forces delta_CP outside {0, pi};
    escalation routing per Decision Points (cross-session contradiction
    workshop). INFO = removability is basis-conditional: J = 0 on a proper
    non-empty subset of the configuration set; scope clause emitted naming
    surviving/failing legs.

strict_PASS_boundary:
  value: "|J| = 1e-12 (THEOREM tolerance; J = 0 exact expected on the removable branch)"
  direction: "<="

boundary_reachable_analytically:
  bool: true
  proof_ref: >
    J = 0 is the exact CP-conservation criterion for the Dirac phase
    (Jarlskog-class rephasing invariant -- the standard machinery named by
    the binding CF; delta_CP in {0, pi} <=> J = 0 at non-degenerate
    angles). The phi = pi point is analytically forced to J = 0 (chain
    Step 5) and the diagonal-m_D leg is analytically forced to J = 0 with

    texture leg are the live content.

reachable_rationals:
  includes_integer_mesh: false
  mesh_density: "discrete closed configuration set: 3 Z3 points x <= 2 U_nu legs = <= 6 evaluations; no continuous scan; no extension permitted"

machinery_pin_map:

  L_max: "N/A -- consumes published npz scalars + verdict-anchored exact values (L_max=12 lineage documented in the npz convention fields)"
  scan_range: "N/A -- discrete pre-declared configuration set (scanning rephasing conventions is unnecessary BY CONSTRUCTION: J is rephasing-invariant, which is exactly why it is the pinned discriminator -- convention-shopping is structurally impossible on this operator)"
  step_size: "N/A"

  scheme: "JARLSKOG-REPHASING-INVARIANT-3X3"
  convention: "ABSOLUTE-EXACT-ALGEBRA"
  random_seed: "N/A -- deterministic"
  GPU_path: "cpu-cap-OMP8 (3x3 complex algebra only)"
  w_source: "abs_w_phi = 1/sqrt(6) EXACT at all three Z3 points + arg_w_M2_phi in {pi, +2pi/3, -2pi/3} from s100a_yukawa_overlap_offdiag.npz (audit 871573da...); verdict anchor s100a_gate_verdicts.txt:36-40"
  d_source: "d-vector d=[7.8935e-01, 1.0000e+00, 3.3183e-01] from the same npz (as-computed RATIO-BLOCKSUM class; unit re-expression NOT needed here -- J is normalization-blind, phases only)"
  unu_legs_pin: "leg (i) diagonal-m_D ALWAYS (S100a-MD-NORMALIZATION landed maps, both diagonal; audit 4f92a551...); leg (ii) gate-2 texture IFF S101-NU-DIRAC-OFFDIAG-TEXTURE verdict line exists in s101_gate_verdicts.txt at dispatch, else texture_leg=N/A in the value string (pre-registered N/A clause -- NOT a PRE-REG-INC)"
  MR_pin: "M_R real-diagonal = D_K B-branch fold energies (J-reality T1/T11); m_1 = 0; NO ordering; Majorana phases tracked separately from delta_CP"
  mass_inputs: "dm2_21_NuFit = 7.49e-05, dm2_31_NuFit = 0.002513 (canonical imports, S100b PROVENANCE-backfilled vintage) for the seesaw leg's mass-eigenbasis construction"
  sector_guard: "phi_CP^K7 = pi/2 is the TRANSIT-sector constant and NEVER enters the leptonic grid (s100b_w2_3_mr_texture_class.npz scoping); the script asserts its absence from every configuration"

audit_discriminators:
  audit_sha256_inputs: ["script", "s100a_yukawa_overlap_offdiag.npz SHA", "s100a_md_normalization.npz SHA", "s100b_w2_3_mr_texture_class.npz SHA", "s100a_gate_verdicts.txt SHA", "canonical_constants.py SHA at runtime", "pinmap (configuration set, legs, tolerances, sector guard)"]
  content_sha256_inputs: ["script"]

substitution_chain:
  required: true
  content: |
    Claim (the discriminator is exact; two configurations are analytically
    forced; the live content is the +-2pi/3 texture leg):
      Step 1: charged doublet block M_l(2x2) = [[d, w],[w*, d]], d real > 0
              (J-forced d1 = d2, S99 BDI; W2-2 npz machine witness
              bdi_pair_max_rel_dev ~ 1.1e-15); |w| = 1/sqrt(6) = 0.4082483
              EXACT; arg(w) = phi in {pi, +2pi/3, -2pi/3}
              [verdict :36-40, audit 871573da...]
      Step 2: eigenvectors (1, +-e^{-i*phi})/sqrt(2)  [exact 2x2 Hermitian]
              => U_l(2x2) = D(phi)*U_0 with D(phi) = diag(1, e^{-i*phi}),
              U_0 = (1/sqrt(2))*[[1, 1],[1, -1]] real
      Step 3: check: D*U_0*diag(d+|w|, d-|w|)*U_0^T*D^dagger
              = [[d, |w|e^{i*phi}],[|w|e^{-i*phi}, d]]  [reproduces M_l --
              factorization verified]
              => U_PMNS = U_l^dagger U_nu = U_0^T * diag(1, e^{+i*phi}) * U_nu
              -- the phase sits BETWEEN two rotations (interior), not as a
              bare row/column phase of U_PMNS. Interior phases are the only
              ones that CAN feed a Dirac phase; whether this one does is
              what J decides.
      Step 4 (leg i, diagonal m_D): U_nu = 1 (up to real Majorana signs) =>
              U_PMNS = U_0^T * diag(1, e^{i*phi}) -- the phase becomes a
              COLUMN phase of U_PMNS = a MAJORANA phase, not a Dirac phase:
              every Jarlskog quartet's phi-dependence cancels column-wise
              => J = 0 EXACTLY; delta_CP unaffected; the Z3 content
              relocates into the Majorana sector (REPORTED, non-gating).
      Step 5 (phi = pi, any real U_nu): diag(1, e^{i*pi}) = diag(1, -1)
              REAL => U_PMNS real => J = 0 identically. The pi point is
              removable by inspection -- the analytic anchor the script
              verifies first at machine eps.
      Step 6 (phi = +-2pi/3, texture leg): interior complex phase between
              non-commuting rotations -- J generically != 0 UNLESS the
              substrate structure cancels it. THIS is the gate's live
              content. No third possibility exists: J is rephasing-
              invariant and complete for the Dirac phase, so J = 0 <=>
              removable and J != 0 <=> non-removable, configuration by
              configuration.
    Direction read-off: the gate's threshold claim is the zero-test
    |J| <= 1e-12 per configuration; branch structure (PASS/FAIL/INFO) as
    pinned in the operator. The Step-4/Step-5 analytic anchors are
    in-script PRE-verifications (any deviation there is a construction
    bug, not physics -- halt and fix before reading Step 6).
```

## §W3-6. S101-CCS-MODELC-KO-DERIVATION

**Promotion context (transcribed)**: S100b-W2-2 identified the framework's Pati-Salam-adjacent classification as the **unique** published variant CCS Model C (G422D) on axes (i) defect-localization + (ii) closure, with sin²θ_W(M_U) = 3/8 exact on three independent routes — but the **axis-(iii) KO score is INDETERMINATE**: the published taxonomy carries no per-variant KO computation. This gate derives it from the PRIMARY CCS-2013/2015 constructions, promoting axis (iii) from indeterminate to determinate (binding: `session-100b-campaign-closeout-synthesis.md:172-176` V.5 + `session-100b-w2-workingpaper.md:267-270`; gate criteria transcribed unchanged). The substrate comparison anchor is the npz-pinned **(KO_dim = 6, (+1, +1, −1))** from `s100b_w2_2_ps_variant_id.npz` — note the W2-2 runtime plan-text-drift correction per `substrate-first-canonical-sourcing.md §(ii.B)` (the stale S100b plan text pinned KO_dim=2; the SHA-pinned npz ground truth is KO_dim=6; this gate consumes the npz, never the stale plan text) — backed by the `permanent-results-registry.md` KO-dim=6 PROVEN record (J = C₂·K antilinear; J² = +1; [J, D_K] = 0; {J, γ₉} = 0).

**Plan-freeze addition (marked per the binding-text rule)**: the binding CF names PASS (match) and FAIL (determinate mismatch) only. A third outcome exists and is pre-registered here as **INFO**: the primary constructions leave the per-variant sign triple UNDERDETERMINED (a sign not pinnable from the texts under any declared convention). Derivation: "promoting the axis-(iii) score from indeterminate to determinate" presupposes the primaries determine it; if they provably do not, the honest verdict is neither match nor mismatch but a documented obstruction — the indeterminacy is then a property of the PRIMARY literature itself, which is itself a determinate (and reportable) finding about the axis.

```yaml
# ---- Identity ----
gate_id: "S101-CCS-MODELC-KO-DERIVATION"
schema_version: "R3"
trigger: "[VERIFY-THEOREM]"
classification: "GEOMETRIC"
agent_type: "connes-ncg-theorist"   # alternate per binding CF: lizzi-spectral-functional-theorist (V.5 names both)
hypothesis: >
  The KO-dimension and real-structure sign triple (epsilon, epsilon',
  epsilon'') of the CCS Model-C (G422D) finite spectral triple, derived
  from the primary CCS-2013/2015 constructions, MATCH the substrate's
  npz-pinned (KO_dim = 6, (+1, +1, -1)) -- re-opening the W2-2 PASS
  pathway (unique-variant + KO-consistency clause).

method:
  description: >
    Solo-theorist derivation; NO new diagonalization. Step A: from the
    on-disk PRIMARY sources (CCS-2013 inner-fluctuations Connes/23;
    CCS-2013 Pati-Salam Connes/24; CCS-2015 grand unification Connes/40;
    Aydemir overview PDF + Connes/27 transcription -- fetched sources
    ONLY per feedback_research-corpus; any gap in the on-disk texts is
    MARKED, never filled from training memory), reconstruct the Model-C
    (G422D) finite triple: H_F (fermion content (4,2,1) + (4bar,1,2) per
    generation, particle + antiparticle sectors; D-symmetric variant),
    the real structure J_F (particle <-> antiparticle swap composed with
    complex conjugation), and the grading gamma_F (L/R chirality). Step
    B: derive the three signs by direct evaluation on the constructed
    H_F: epsilon = sign(J_F^2); epsilon' = the (anti)commutation sign of
    J_F with D_F on the Model-C D_F form; epsilon'' = the
    (anti)commutation sign of J_F with gamma_F. Every step visible;
    small finite-matrix numeric witnesses (J_F^2, anticommutators)
    computed where the representation is explicit. Step C: KO_dim = the
    unique even row of the KO sign table matching the derived triple
    (chain below). Step D: discrete match comparison against the
    substrate anchor (6, (+1, +1, -1)) loaded from
    s100b_w2_2_ps_variant_id.npz; the registry KO-dim=6 PROVEN record is
    the substrate-side cross-reference. If a sign is provably
    convention-unpinnable from the primaries, document the obstruction
    (which text, which missing convention) and land INFO.
  producing_script: "computations/session-101/s101_ccs_modelc_ko_derivation.py"

# ---- PRDR Checklist (8 items) ----
operator:
  type: "set (discrete exact match, three-branch)"
  form: >
    Derived tuple T_C = (KO_dim, epsilon, epsilon', epsilon'') for Model C
    vs substrate anchor T_S = (6, +1, +1, -1). PASS = T_C == T_S (exact
    discrete equality, all four slots). FAIL = T_C determinate AND
    T_C != T_S (any slot). INFO = T_C underdetermined at the primary
    constructions (documented obstruction; marked plan-freeze addition).

strict_PASS_boundary:
  value: "exact discrete equality on the 4-tuple (KO_dim, epsilon, epsilon', epsilon'') = (6, +1, +1, -1); no numerical tolerance (sign/integer match)"
  direction: "="

boundary_reachable_analytically:
  bool: true
  proof_ref: >
    The KO classification is the closed-form Connes sign table (chain
    below); the substrate side of the comparison is the PROVEN KO-dim=6
    record (permanent-results-registry; J^2 = +1, [J, D_K] = 0,
    {J, gamma_9} = 0 at machine eps) with the npz-pinned triple
    (+1, +1, -1) -- the boundary is a discrete table row, reachable by
    construction.

reachable_rationals:
  includes_integer_mesh: true
  mesh_density: "discrete -- 8 KO classes (Z/8) x sign triples; the even-grading admissible set is 4 rows; single comparison point"

machinery_pin_map:
  N_eval: "1 H_F reconstruction + 3 sign derivations (epsilon, epsilon', epsilon'') + 1 table-row lookup + 1 discrete match comparison"
  L_max: "N/A -- finite triple F (H_F dimension counted in-script from the Model-C content; no Peter-Weyl truncation)"
  scan_range: "N/A -- no swept parameter (derivation over a fixed published construction)"
```

## §W3-7. S101-PS-RGE-MODELC-SIN2-MZ

**Form selection (plan-freeze pin — the binding text requires ONE of two forms pre-registered NOW; derivation shown per the binding-text rule)**: the binding CF (`session-100b-campaign-closeout-synthesis.md:178-182` V.6 + `session-100b-w2-workingpaper.md:273-275` CF-W2-1) offers (form 1) a `|sin²θ_W(M_Z)_ModelC − datum|` PASS band, or (form 2) an INFO-by-design two-route comparison with pre-declared report structure. **Form 2 is pinned.** Derivation of the selection: (i) form 1 requires the FORWARD formulation (pick M_C, run down, compare at M_Z) — but no substrate-pinned M_C exists, so a forward-form M_C would be a scanned-and-tuned free parameter aimed at the PASS band: iterate-until-PASS adjacency (`v3-closure-recovery.md` PROHIBITED Class 6) AND a PRU Class-8 unpinned-machinery defect; (ii) the honest formulation is the INVERSE one-loop system (input the three measured M_Z couplings, solve exactly for M_C, M_U, α_U from matching + the 3/8 boundary) — which is exactly determined with ZERO free parameters, but under it sin²θ_W(M_Z) is an INPUT, making the form-1 band a load-and-compare-to-self (Class-4 adjacency); (iii) therefore the admissible pre-registration is form 2: INFO-by-design with the existence/ordering FAIL clause as the sharp discriminator and the four-element report pre-declared in the operator block. PASS is NOT REACHABLE BY DESIGN (pre-declared).

**Datum reconciliation (SOURCE-RECON at plan-freeze)**: the binding text quotes "PDG sin²θ_W(M_Z) = 0.23121 ± 0.00004"; the canonical import is `sin2_thetaW_MSbar = 0.23122` (no PROVENANCE entry — PDG-class). Δ = 1e-5 = 0.25 σ_PDG; D_max = |log₁₀(0.23122/0.23121)| = 1.88e-5 OOM → no-action band per `epistemic-discipline.md §"Source Reconciliation"`. The CANONICAL IMPORT is the comparison datum (scripts import, never hardcode, per `substrate-first-canonical-sourcing.md`); the binding-text publication form is recorded here so the drift is visible, not silent.

**Depends on (`output-standards.md` enumeration — the hard-sequencing record the Run-order paragraph points at)**:
- `S101-CCS-MODELC-KO-DERIVATION` (UPSTREAM GATE, **hard-sequenced**: this gate dispatches only AFTER gate 6's verdict line exists; gate-6 FAIL → mechanical closure per Decision Points)
- `s100b_w2_2_ps_variant_id.npz` (UPSTREAM DATA: variant ID, scalar content, sin² rationals; SHA `60348f50…`)
- `computations/session-101/s101_gate_verdicts.txt` (IN-SESSION: gate-6 verdict capture for the ko_axis tag)
- `canonical_constants.py`: `sin2_thetaW_MSbar`, `M_Z`, `alpha_em_MZ_inv`, `alpha_s_MZ_obs`, `M_Pl_unreduced` (CANONICAL IMPORTS)
- Aydemir PDF (METHODOLOGICAL cross-check of the computed beta coefficients + published (M_C, M_U) OOM; SHA `2fb24a7a…`)
